overview: The 2026 manual introduces major new rules worth reviewing, most notably the hands-free mobile device law, the choice between a REAL ID and a Standard license, and updated road test procedures such as the 14-day retake wait, examiner rejection criteria, and new vehicle equipment requirements. It adds several entirely new safety topics, including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, drowsy driving, the Vulnerable Road Users Law with a four-foot bicycle passing distance, recommended car safety kits, proper backing-up technique, courtesy crashes, and the Driver Removal Law for crashes. Drivers should also note changes to common standards, like switching from the two-second to the three-second following distance, the new 25 mph thickly settled district limit, updated OUI penalties and reinstatement fees, and new traffic markings such as bus lanes, bicycle signals, and rectangular rapid flashing beacons. Finally, some older content has been dropped, including specialty license plate listings, salvage title procedures, and NATO driving privileges.

sections.title: REAL ID vs. Standard Massachusetts Card
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes a choice between a REAL ID and a Standard Massachusetts driver's license or ID card, replacing the 2017 manual's note that REAL ID systems were still in development.
bullets: "You need to choose either a REAL ID Massachusetts Driver's License or ID Card or a Standard Massachusetts Driver's License or ID Card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"A Standard Massachusetts Driver's License offers the same driving privileges as a REAL ID Massachusetts Driver's License. However, it is NOT an acceptable form of identification for the federal purposes mentioned above." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State-to-State Verification Program
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the State-to-State program that cancels licenses or ID cards issued by other participating states when a Massachusetts card is issued.
bullets: "Massachusetts is part of the State-to-State program, which checks valid driver licenses and state issued ID cards issued by other participating states." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-Country Driver Criminal Penalty
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific criminal penalty for a violation of Chapter 90, Section 10 regarding out-of-country drivers, which was not stated in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "A violation of Section 10 is a criminal violation and a first offense is subject to a fine of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Restriction Code Letters
sections.description: The 2026 manual revises the list of restriction code letters, adding numerous new CDL and medical codes (e.g., medical log/glucose, intrastate-only, medical variance) compared to the simpler 2017 list.
bullets: "2 Medical Log / Glucose Required" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"V Medical Variance" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"W Intrastate Medical Waiver" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prorated License Length for Lawful Presence
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for issuing a REAL ID license for less than five years based on the applicant's authorized lawful presence, with a prorated fee.
bullets: "A REAL ID License or ID card can be issued for a period of less than five years if an applicant's authorized lawful presence (as established by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security) is for a shorter period." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"The minimum acceptable period of lawful presence is 12 months." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Electronic Identification Document Verification
sections.description: The 2026 manual describes a new electronic checking process for identification documents against national and state databases with stated processing timeframes.
bullets: "The Registry will initiate electronic checks for most identification documents with national and state databases." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"These cases are generally resolved within three to five business days, but in rare occasions may be up to twenty days." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Social Security Number Affidavit Option
sections.description: A new option allows applicants without an SSN to present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License.
bullets: "If you do not have an SSN and cannot apply for one, you can present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License (see Mass.Gov/ID for more information)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Online Learner's Permit Exam
sections.description: The learner's permit exam can now be taken online after submitting an application, whereas previously it was only available on a walk-in basis at a service center.
bullets: "They are also available online at Mass.Gov/RMV after you submit your application. If you pass the exam online but cannot print the permit, you can call the RMV Contact Center at 857-368-8110." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: 14-Day Wait After Failed Road Test
sections.description: A new rule requires waiting at least 14 days before retaking a road test after failing or not appearing.
bullets: "If you fail a road test or do not appear for your scheduled test, you must wait at least 14 days before taking another test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rejected Road Tests Criteria
sections.description: New explicit criteria allow examiners to reject road tests for signs of impairment, odor of alcohol or cannabis, or presence of unsupervised children or animals.
bullets: "An odor of alcohol or cannabis is coming from you or your sponsor, including from clothing or inside the vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Minor children, babies, or animals are present in the vehicle and cannot be left unsupervised at the Service Center. Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limit on Road Test Sponsorship
sections.description: A new limit prohibits operators from sponsoring more than three different applicants within a one year period without RMV approval.
bullets: "Operators are not allowed to sponsor more than three different applicants within a one year period without approval from the RMV Road Test Program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Updated Insurance Minimum Limits for Road Test Vehicles
sections.description: The minimum insurance coverage limits for out-of-state vehicles used in road tests were increased.
bullets: "If your test vehicle is registered out of state, you must show the examiner proof of insurance coverage equal to Massachusetts minimum limits, which are $25,000/$50,000 for bodily injury and $30,000 for property damage." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking Brake Testing Requirement
sections.description: New specific regulatory requirements for testing the parking brake before a road test are described, including RPM thresholds.
bullets: "Massachusetts regulation 540 CMR 4.04 (4) requires that parking brakes be tested by accelerating the motor to 1,200 to 1,300 RPMs with the vehicle in the lowest gear. The examiner will not allow the road test to proceed if the parking brake does not work as required by law." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"The parking brake can be manual or electric (push or pull button)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialized Features No Longer Need Disabling
sections.description: Whereas the 2017 manual required specialized features to be turned off or disabled for the road test, the 2026 manual states these devices do not need to be disabled.
bullets: "These devices will not need to be disabled. However, your driving skills and abilities without relying only on these specialized features will be tested." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Updated Road Test Arrival Time
sections.description: The recommended arrival time before a road test was changed from approximately five minutes to approximately 15 minutes early.
bullets: "You should arrive approximately 15 minutes early for your scheduled road test appointment." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rental Vehicle Authorization Must Include Sponsor
sections.description: The rental company letter for a road test vehicle must now authorize both the applicant and the sponsor to use the vehicle.
bullets: "you must show your examiner your rental agreement and a letter from the rental company, on its letterhead, that authorizes you and your sponsor to use the vehicle for a driver’s license road test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Temporary License Validity After Road Test
sections.description: The temporary license validity period after passing the road test was extended from 30 days to 60 days.
bullets: "the examiner will validate your learner's permit and it will become a temporary license, valid up to 60 days (unless the permit expires before that)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"within 60 days, you must either pay online or make a reservation to take the permit with the road test results indicated to a service center" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Photo Age for Service Center Visit
sections.description: The age threshold for needing to visit a service center for a license due to an old photo changed from 21 to 20.
bullets: "If you are over the age of 20, but still have a photo on file from when you were under 20, you will need to make a reservation to visit a service center to obtain your license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Permit Conversion Requirements
sections.description: Permit conversion now requires presenting a certified driving record not more than 30 days old, which was not required in the 2017 edition.
bullets: "You must also provide a certified driving record (not more than 30 days old)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Permanent License Mail Timeframe
sections.description: The timeframe to call the RMV if the permanent license does not arrive changed from four weeks to 30 days, and mailing time changed to 10-14 business days.
bullets: "If your permanent license does not arrive in the mail within 30 days, please call the RMV Contact Center." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"and are generally mailed to you within 10-14 business days after you visit the RMV Service Center ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Class M Privilege Add-On Fee
sections.description: The fee to add motorcycle privileges to a license class changed from a flat $15 to $3 per year.
bullets: "*To add motorcycle privileges (Class M) to any of these license classes, you must pay an additional $3.00 per year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prorated License Fees
sections.description: Fees for licenses issued for less than five years will now be prorated based on length of issuance, a provision not present in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "Fees for licenses issued for less than five years will be prorated based on length of issuance." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Fee Must Be Paid Before Rebooking
sections.description: The road test fee must now be paid prior to a new test being booked, an explicit requirement added in 2026.
bullets: "you will still be charged the $35 fee, which must be paid prior to a new test being booked" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emotional Support Animals in Road Test Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual explicitly distinguishes that trained service animals are allowed but emotional support animals are not, a distinction not present in 2017.
bullets: "Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Veteran's Indicator Proof In Person
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies that proof of honorable discharge must be presented in person with a reservation at an RMV Service Center.
bullets: "the following documents must be presented as proof of honorable discharge in person with a reservation at an RMV Service Center" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Car Safety Kits
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section recommending essential safety items to carry in the vehicle, which did not exist in 2017.
bullets: "It is recommended to carry the following items in your vehicle: • Reflective Safety Vest • Reflective Warning Triangles or LED Flares • First Aid Kit • Glass Breaker Tool • White and red cloths to tie to your vehicle during a breakdown" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers should equip their vehicles with winter tires, an ice scraper, jumper cables, and extra warm clothing ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Required Passenger Vehicle Safety Equipment
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds new required equipment items including a working driver's side window that moves up and down and specifies safety belts must be undamaged.
bullets: "• A working, undamaged safety belt for the driver and all passengers" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"• A working driver's side window that moves up and down" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headphones and Wireless Device Restriction
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the headphone prohibition to include any other wired or wireless device that restricts attention to the environment.
bullets: "It is illegal to wear a radio headset, headphones, or any other wired or wireless device that restricts your attention to the environment while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Loud Noise Levels in Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new advisory to avoid loud noise levels so the driver can hear emergency vehicle sirens, not present in 2017.
bullets: "Avoid loud noise levels in your vehicle so you can hear emergency vehicle sirens." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Road Test Scheduling Process
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the order of the scheduling process so the road test is booked first before contacting the Commission for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing for an interpreter.
bullets: "The Driver Licensing Department will then contact you to book the road test. Once the test is booked, they will contact the Commission for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing to arrange for an interpreter." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Device Law
sections.description: Massachusetts now prohibits use of hand-held mobile electronic devices while driving, requiring hands-free mode for drivers 18 and older.
bullets: "The use of hand-held mobile electronic devices (including cell phones) while driving is prohibited in Massachusetts (Chapter 90, Section 13B and Chapter 122 of the Acts of 2019)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers 18 and older can only use mobile electronic devices in “hands-free” mode while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalties for Mobile Device Use
sections.description: The penalty structure for using a hand-held mobile device now includes specific fines and a mandatory distracted driving program.
bullets: "1st offense - $100 fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"2nd offense - $250 fine, plus mandatory completion of a distracted driving educational program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"3rd and subsequent offenses - $500 fine, plus insurance surcharge and mandatory completion of a distracted driving program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS).
bullets: "Many cars and trucks now come with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). These can make driving safer, but only if used correctly." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drowsy Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated section on the dangers of drowsy driving.
bullets: "Driving while tired or drowsy can be deadly. 633 people died in 2020 from drowsy driving related crashes (source: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vulnerable Road Users Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Vulnerable Road Users Law requiring a minimum four-foot passing distance.
bullets: "When you pass a vulnerable road user, you must leave a safe passing distance of at least four feet between your vehicle and the road user." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

images.alt: Road sign with text reading "MOTORISTS GIVE 4 FT TO PASS" and an image of a bicycle

sections.title: Following Distance Rule
sections.description: The recommended minimum following distance was changed from the two-second rule to the three-second rule.
bullets: "Use the "three-second" rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you reach the object before you count three, you are too close." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Following Distances for Motorcycles and Heavy Equipment
sections.description: Specific time-based following distances were added for motorcycles and heavy equipment.
bullets: "Keep more space (at least four seconds) behind a motorcycle than you would for another vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least ten seconds) between your vehicle and heavy equipment (for example, dump trucks, tractors)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Plate Condition
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a requirement that license plates be clean and visible from 60 feet at night.
bullets: "You must keep your license plates clean and they cannot be blocked by anything. Your plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Clearing Snow and Ice from Vehicle
sections.description: The winter driving requirement to clear snow and ice now specifies clearing the roof, hood, and trunk, whereas the 2017 manual only mentioned the roof.
bullets: "Remove ALL ice and snow from your vehicle before driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"It is very important that you clear the roof, hood, and trunk so ice and snow does not blow into vehicles behind you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Awareness of Deaf or Hard of Hearing Road Users
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance about Deaf or Hard of Hearing pedestrians, bicyclists, and drivers.
bullets: "Be aware that pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers may not hear you. This is especially important in crosswalks and parking lots. One out of every five individuals of driving age is Deaf or Hard of Hearing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Deaf or Hard of Hearing individuals – It is impossible to visually identify someone who is Deaf or Hard of Hearing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: At-Fault Crash Claim Payment Threshold
sections.description: The dollar amount of insurance claim payment that defines an at-fault crash was raised from $500 to $1000.
bullets: "Has paid more than $1000 for collision, limited collision, or damage to someone else’s property or has paid more than $1000 for bodily injury (if there is no collision or damage to someone else’s property over $1000 from the same incident)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Unattested Driving Record Fee
sections.description: The fee for an unattested driving record increased from $6 to $8.
bullets: "If you do not need the driving record to be attested, you can order an unattested driving record for $8 (this option is only available online)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Refund of Hearing Filing Fee
sections.description: A new provision allows the $25 filing fee to be refunded if found not responsible for all violations on the citation.
bullets: "If you are found NOT RESPONSIBLE by the court for ALL violations on the civil citation, the $25 filing fee will be refunded." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorcycle Following Distance
sections.description: The recommended following distance comparison for other motor vehicles changed from two-second to three-second.
bullets: "Use a four- second following distance (compared to a three-second for other motor vehicles)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Safe Options to Get Home After Drinking
sections.description: New guidance encourages drivers to use a designated driver, taxi, or rideshare app after drinking.
bullets: "If you have used, or plan on using alcohol, make sure you have a safe option to get home. Appoint a designated driver, take a taxi, use a rideshare app like Uber or Lyft, or call a friend or family member for a ride." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Device Road Tests
sections.description: A new procedure was added explaining how drivers required to use an Ignition Interlock Device can schedule a road test.
bullets: "If you are required to use an Ignition Interlock Device and need to schedule a road test, you can schedule it online at Mass.Gov/RMV if you can provide a vehicle that has the device installed, has a center console brake, and has a seat for the sponsor." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI Suspension and Reinstatement Fee Structure
sections.description: The criminal offenses chart now lists specific per-offense suspension periods and graduated reinstatement fees for OUI convictions.
bullets: "Operating under the influence of alcohol or drugs One year (first) Two years (second) Eight years (third) Ten years (fourth) Lifetime (fifth) $500 (first) $700 (second) $1200 (third) $1200 (fourth)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension for Defacing Property/Graffiti
sections.description: A new offense was added to the criminal offenses chart suspending a license for defacing property or applying graffiti.
bullets: "Defacing real or personal property, spraying paint or applying stickers or other graffiti (Operation of a ve­ hicle is not required) One year (or delay of one year in obtaining a License) $100" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: 25 MPH Speed Limit in Thickly Settled Districts
sections.description: New language allows communities to set a 25 mph limit in thickly settled districts unless posted otherwise, with signs at all entrances.
bullets: "Some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph unless posted otherwise (per M.G.L. c90, Section 17c). Signs are posted at all entrances to these cities and towns." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Reinstatement Hearings by Phone
sections.description: Reinstatement hearings are now scheduled online and conducted by phone rather than on a walk-in basis at specific locations.
bullets: "Visit Mass.Gov/RMV for hearing information and to schedule a hearing. The Hearings Officer will then call you and conduct the hearing by phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol Effects on Safety Belt Use and Lane Control
sections.description: New detail describes how alcohol makes drivers less likely to use safety belts, more likely to speed, and less able to stay in their lane.
bullets: "Alcohol use also makes you less likely to remember to use your safety belt, more likely to speed, and less able to stay in your lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon
sections.description: A new pedestrian signal device not described in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons are activated by pedestrians manually by a push button or by a pedestrian detection system. They are often located in intersections without traffic signals or at mid-block crosswalks. When activated, amber lights flash in an irregular pattern. You must stop for pedestrians when the beacon is flashing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Signals
sections.description: A new type of traffic signal specifically for bicyclists not described in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle signals are lights specifically meant for bicyclists. They display as steady red, yellow, and green bicycle symbols. When the signal is green, bicyclists can go through busy intersections while motor vehicles are stopped, protecting them from turning vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Flashing Yellow Arrow
sections.description: The flashing yellow arrow now permits turning right in addition to left.
bullets: "A flashing yellow arrow allows you to turn left or right in the direction of the arrow when oncoming traffic has a green light but there is a break in traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advisory Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: A new type of bicycle lane not described in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "Advisory bicycle lanes are becoming common on streets that are too narrow for a full bicycle lane, but still have a lot of bicycle traffic. They are dashed on one or both sides to indicate that motor vehicles may use the lane space when necessary, but they must always yield to bicyclists first." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Lanes
sections.description: A new pavement marking topic describing red pavement for transit not in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "Red pavement is used for travel lanes or station stops used by public transit systems. This includes buses, streetcars, trolleys, light-rail trains, and rapid transit fleets." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies bicycle lanes are marked by solid white lines and are five feet wide, a detail not in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle lanes are portions of the roadway that are intended for use by bicyclists and are typically marked by solid white lines, along with pavement markings and signs. They are five feet wide." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Courtesy Crashes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section warning drivers about crashes caused by waving others through traffic.
bullets: "Sometimes, drivers trying to be nice can cause confusion resulting in "courtesy crashes". Waving people in through stopped traffic, or driving through traffic when someone waves you in, creates a dangerous situation and can easily result in a crash." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep in mind that oncoming traffic has the right-of-way, regardless of whether someone is waving at you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Backing Up
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section with steps for backing up a vehicle.
bullets: "Use the following steps when backing up:" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Shift into reverse and start backing up, while looking over your right shoulder. Ensure a safe and smooth speed while maintaning your lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Passing Stopped Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section prohibiting passing of stopped or turning vehicles.
bullets: "Do not pass vehicles that are stopped or are turning (both at intersections and at non-intersections). They may be stopped for another vehicle, a person, or an animal that you cannot see." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the move-over law to specify the direction of moving over and to include highway and recovery vehicles.
bullets: "yield the right-of­ way by safely "moving over" to a lane that is not next to the lane the emergency, highway, or recovery vehicle is occupying." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Depending on where the emergency vehicle is parked, you may need to move to the right or to the left." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Minimum Bicycle Passing Distance
sections.description: The minimum distance a motorist must stay away when passing a bicycle increased from three feet to four feet.
bullets: "You must stay at least four feet away when passing. (Chap. 89, Sec. 2)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Parking in a Bicycle Lane
sections.description: Parking in a bicycle lane is newly listed as a prohibited parking location.
bullets: "In Massachusetts, you may not park your vehicle in a bicycle lane" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Parking in HP-DV Crosshatch Area
sections.description: Parking in a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space is newly prohibited even for those with disability plates or placards.
bullets: "In a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, even if you have disability plates or a placard" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalty for Refusing or Giving False Name/Address During a Stop
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific fine and arrest consequence for failing to provide or providing a false name and address when stopped without license and registration.
bullets: "If you do not have your license and registration, the officer can ask for your name and address and, if you do not own the vehicle, the name and address of the owner. If you fail to comply, or provide a false name or address, you can be fined $100 (Chapter 90, Section 25). You can also be arrested and face criminal charges if you refuse." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Proof of Insurance for Out-of-State Stops
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance about officers in other jurisdictions requesting proof of insurance and explains Massachusetts does not issue insurance cards.
bullets: "Outside of Massachusetts, an officer may also request \"proof of insurance\" (based on that jurisdiction's laws). Your registration identifies your insurance carrier and explains that an insurance card is not issued under Massachusetts law." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Signing a Citation
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance that Massachusetts does not require signing a citation while other jurisdictions do, and that a signature only confirms receipt.
bullets: "Massachusetts does not require you to sign a citation, but some other jurisdictions do. Read a citation before signing. Your signature should only confirm receipt of the citation, not proof of a violation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Removal Law After a Crash
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Driver Removal Law requiring vehicles to be moved out of travel lanes when there are no injuries.
bullets: "If there are no injuries, the Driver Removal Law requires that vehicles be moved out of travel lanes to a safe location." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Warning Triangle and Safety Vest Placement for Breakdowns
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands breakdown instructions with detailed warning triangle/LED flare placement distances and safety vest use that were not in the 2017 manual.
bullets: "If you stop on a divided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: • 10 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet behind your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"If you stop on a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions or on an undivided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: • 10 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet behind your vehicle • 100 feet in front of your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Put your safety vest on while still inside the vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialty License Plates (Atlantic White Shark Conservancy, Basketball Hall of Fame, etc.)
sections.description: The detailed list of specialty plates and their associated charitable beneficiaries and $40 biennial fees is absent from the 2026 manual.
bullets: "Atlantic White Shark Conservancy plates benefit the Atlantic White Shark Conservancy Inc. The special plate fee is $40 every two years." (2017 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialty License Plates (Conquer Cancer, Cure Breast Cancer, Fallen Heroes, Freemasonry)
sections.description: The list of charitable specialty plates and their beneficiaries and fees is absent from the 2026 manual.
bullets: "Conquer Cancer plates benefit the Conquer Cancer Coalition of Massachusetts. The special plate fee is $40 every two years." (2017 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Salvage Repairable Title
sections.description: The explanation of when a vehicle is declared a total loss and salvage title procedures is absent from the 2026 manual.
bullets: "If your vehicle becomes inoperable due to fire, vandalism, collision, theft, flood, or another event to such an extent that you or, if insured, your insurer considers it uneconomical to repair the vehicle, the vehicle will be declared a total loss." (2017 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Salvage Title Insurer Assignment Procedures
sections.description: The procedures for assigning title to an insurer and obtaining a salvage title are absent from the 2026 manual.
bullets: "If the vehicle is insured and the insurer retains the vehicle, you will have to assign your title to the insurer." (2017 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: NATO Military Personnel and Dependents Driving Privileges
sections.description: The provisions allowing NATO military and civilian dependents to drive on their home country license for up to one year under the Multilateral Road Traffic Convention of 1949 are absent from the 2026 manual.
bullets: "Dependents of military personnel of NATO force personnel on assignment in the U.S., and dependents of civilian employees assigned to those NATO forces, who are from one of the NATO member countries listed below, may legally drive on the roads of the Commonwealth, on their home country license, for up to one year from the date of arrival, under the Multilateral Road Traffic Convention of 1949 or applicable reciprocal agreements." (2017 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
